segments.caption: Pharaoh ordered every newborn boy of Bani Israel killed.
segments.vo: Pharaoh ordered every newborn boy of Bani Israel killed.

segments.caption: But Allah told one mother: nurse him, then cast him into the river.
segments.vo: But Allah told one mother: nurse him, then cast him into the river.

segments.caption: The river carried him straight to Pharaoh's palace.
segments.vo: The river carried him straight to Pharaoh's palace.

segments.caption: Pharaoh's wife, Asiya, said: do not kill him.
segments.vo: Pharaoh's wife, Aasiya, said: do not kill him.

segments.caption: He refused every nurse, until his sister led them to his own mother.
segments.vo: He refused every nurse, until his sister led them to his own mother.

segments.caption: Allah's promise came true. He was back in her arms.
segments.vo: Allah's promise came true. He was back in her arms.

segments.caption: But the palace would not hold him forever. Follow for Part 2.
